fact: Senegal, like other UEMOA and ECOWAS member states, transposed the community provisions into national law through Law No. 2011-01 of 24 February 2011 (Code des Télécommunications), though several implementing decrees remained unsigned.
title: Stratégie nationale Sénégal Numérique 2025
publisher: Ministère des Postes et des Télécommunications
